source: VID_20240618_170515_00_007.insv, static, 30 s .. 1801 s (warm-up done after ~900 s)
units: continuous-time: noise in rad/s/sqrt(Hz), m/s^2/sqrt(Hz); bias random walk in rad/s^2/sqrt(Hz), m/s^3/sqrt(Hz)
method: Allan deviation read at tau = 1 s (above the 17.3 Hz vibration line) and cross-checked with the PSD floor 5-50 Hz; bias random walk from the rising tail of the post-warm-up curves (rough, 15 min of data)
note: Static values. For VIO in flight use the in-flight noise (gyro ~3.5e-3, accel ~6e-2; estimated from the vibration spectrum of a flight recording, not calibrated) or at least inflate these ~10x.
